2026-10-18 bounded recovery-metadata update: [Published records](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/44985de06680984e69b98aa6300ec395e8aace15/attestations/scientific-core/eae45684/shared-jacobi-integration-native-amd/README.md) include additional read-only Windows routes. Current-user Recent shortcuts gave no lead; FileHistory configuration locations were absent. RecycleBin metadata identified a deleted Desktop/Sirius directory (deletion2026-10-17T23:22:41Z), but its surviving payload directory was empty. Windows Search filename metadata in current-user Desktop/Documents/Downloads/OneDrive returned no Sirius/render/comparator/tape matches (boundedTOP60,nottruncated). No file content/cloud hydration/restore/elevation occurred.

CIM shadow-copy enumeration was unavailable and vssadmin lacked Windows privileges. These are explicit coverage gaps, not proof that no snapshots/backups exist. The indexed/RecycleBin negatives are scoped and do not establish universal absence. The user's No clue answer is not a waiver. Original July tapes/manifests/comparator identity remains unresolved; separately labelled NEW_RECONSTRUCTION outputs cannot replace it. No repeated unchanged checkout/user-folder search was started.

---

The user follow-up did not identify another path or backup location for the original July renderer tapes, manifests or comparator. Original-image identity therefore remains unresolved. The three exact newly reconstructed pairs remain classified as NEW_RECONSTRUCTION; this answer does not waive or satisfy the original identity obligation.

A further bounded filename/metadata search found no candidates under `C:\Users\alarisadmin\Desktop`, `Documents`, `Downloads`, `Pictures` and `OneDrive`: all five roots were accessible, with nine directory enumerations and 18 entries, and no access or search-limit gaps. This was a name search for Sirius/DNGR/July/tape/manifest/comparator/2026-07 terms, not a content audit or a search of all storage. Three Documents links were not followed; Pictures was searched directly. No AppData, system directories, other users, other clones, network locations or cloud hydration were included. The retained preparation records also explicitly say that the historical tapes, manifest and comparator were not recovered. Original provenance remains open.
